findings.summary: The no-description path (line 183) uses `compgen -W "$out"`, which splits on whitespace and expands `$` and backticks, while the description path (line 194) does a literal prefix match, so the same completion behaves differently depending on whether any line has a description.

judge.reason: Describes a different inconsistency between paths (word splitting/expansion), not the empty-candidate regression; the literal match is arguably intended.
